blocks.body: Divorce is the one transition in this list where professional counsel is close to mandatory: state property law decides what is marital, and agreements are hard to reopen. If a full-service lawyer is out of reach, look for legal aid or ask whether a lawyer will help with only part of the case. Build a complete list of accounts, debts and policies first; it is also the start of your own net-worth snapshot. If you fear for your safety or your spouse controls the money, first call the national domestic violence hotline, which can connect you with local help, then open an account in your own name and pull your free credit reports. A decree does not bind your lenders: until a joint debt is paid off, refinanced without your name or released by the lender, the lender can generally still collect from you. Note the date the divorce becomes final: a former spouse married 10 years or more before that date may later draw Social Security on the other's record.
blocks.plain: Divorce is the one event on this list where a lawyer is close to a must: your state's property law decides what counts as shared, and a signed agreement is hard to undo. If you can't pay a lawyer for the whole case, look for legal aid or ask whether a lawyer will help with just part of it. First, list every account, debt and insurance policy. That list is also the start of your own net-worth snapshot. If you are afraid for your safety or your spouse controls the money, first call the national domestic violence hotline, which can connect you with help near you. Then open a bank account in your own name and get your free credit reports. The divorce papers don't bind your lenders: until a shared debt is paid off, refinanced without your name, or the lender lets you off it, the lender can usually still make you pay. Write down the date the divorce becomes final. A former spouse who was married 10 years or more before that date may later get Social Security based on the other's work record.

State property law decides what is marital

Build a complete inventory of accounts, debts, policies first

If safety or financial control is a concern, first call the national domestic violence hotline (which connects callers with local help), then open an account in your own name and pull free credit reports
A decree does not bind lenders; a creditor can generally collect on a joint debt until it is paid off, refinanced without your name, or you are released
Note the final date: a former spouse married 10 years or more before it may later draw Social Security on the other's record

blocks.body: An employer plan can only pay a former spouse under a qualified domestic relations order (QDRO); distributions to the alternate payee under a QDRO are exempt from the 10% additional tax, but they are generally still taxable income, and the exemption does not apply to withdrawals from an IRA, so it is lost if the money is rolled into one first. IRAs are divided by a transfer incident to divorce, which is not a taxable distribution. Cashing out instead of using these routes can turn a split into a tax bill. Compare shares after tax: pre-tax retirement money is taxed when withdrawn, qualified Roth withdrawals are not, and stock you receive keeps your spouse's old tax basis, so a dollar in each is not worth the same.
blocks.plain: A job-based plan can only pay a former spouse under a court order called a qualified domestic relations order (QDRO). Money paid to the former spouse under a QDRO skips the extra 10% tax, but it is usually still taxed as income. That break does not apply to withdrawals from an IRA, so it is lost if the money is moved into an IRA first. An IRA is split by a transfer made as part of the divorce, which isn't taxed as a withdrawal. Cashing out instead of using these routes can turn the split into a tax bill. Compare what each share is worth after tax: pre-tax retirement money is taxed when you take it out, qualified Roth withdrawals are not, and stock you receive keeps your spouse's old tax cost, so a dollar of each is not worth the same.

QDRO distributions to the alternate payee are exempt from the 10% additional tax
They are generally still taxable income
The exemption does not apply to IRA withdrawals, so rolling the money into an IRA first loses it
IRAs are divided by transfer incident to divorce, not taxable
transfer made as part of the divorce
Cashing out instead can create a tax bill
Compare shares after tax: pre-tax money is taxed on withdrawal, qualified Roth withdrawals are not, received stock keeps the old basis

blocks.body: Many states automatically revoke an ex-spouse as beneficiary of some non-probate assets, but for employer plans governed by ERISA the Supreme Court held that the plan documents control (Egelhoff v. Egelhoff, 2001). Do not rely on state law: file new forms on every account and policy as soon as you are allowed to. Your state may bar beneficiary changes while the case is pending, and your settlement or a court order may require you to keep your ex as beneficiary, for example on life insurance that secures support. Ask your lawyer whether you can name a new agent on your power of attorney and health care directive now.
blocks.plain: Many states automatically remove an ex-spouse as beneficiary on some accounts. But for job-based plans covered by ERISA, the Supreme Court ruled that the plan's own papers win (Egelhoff v. Egelhoff, 2001). Don't count on state law: file new beneficiary forms on every account and policy as soon as you are allowed to. Your state may not allow beneficiary changes while the divorce is still going on. And your settlement or a court order may say you must keep your ex as beneficiary, for example on life insurance that backs support payments. Ask your lawyer whether you can name someone new to act for you on your power of attorney and health care directive now.

blocks.body: Marital status on December 31 sets filing status for the year, but a parent still married then may file as head of household if the spouse did not live in the home for the last 6 months of the year and the parent paid more than half the cost of a home the child lived in for more than half the year. The parent the child spent more nights with generally claims the child unless that parent signs a release (Form 8332). Losing coverage under a spouse's plan is a COBRA qualifying event (up to 36 months for a former spouse) and a Marketplace special enrollment trigger. For a divorce or legal separation the law puts the notice on you or your former spouse: tell the plan administrator within 60 days of the event, or the COBRA right can be lost. Before paying for COBRA, compare Marketplace plans and check Medicaid, which you can join any time of year if you qualify.
blocks.plain: Whether you're married on December 31 sets your filing status for the year. But a parent who is still married then may be able to file as head of household. This works if the spouse did not live in the home for the last 6 months of the year, and the parent paid more than half the cost of a home the child lived in for more than half the year. The parent the child spent more nights with generally claims the child, unless that parent signs a release (Form 8332). Losing coverage under a spouse's plan lets you use COBRA (up to 36 months for a former spouse) and opens a Marketplace special enrollment window. For a divorce or legal separation, the law puts the notice on you or your former spouse: tell the plan administrator within 60 days of the event, or you can lose the COBRA right. Before you pay for COBRA, compare Marketplace plans and check Medicaid. If you qualify, you can sign up for Medicaid at any time of year.

draft.title: Protect yourself and your credit first
draft.body: If you fear for your safety or your spouse controls the money, first call the national domestic violence hotline, which can connect you with local help, then open an account in your own name and pull your free credit reports. A decree does not bind your lenders: until a joint debt is paid off, refinanced without your name or released by the lender, the lender can generally still collect from you.
draft.plain: If you are afraid for your safety or your spouse controls the money, first call the national domestic violence hotline, which can connect you with help near you. Then open a bank account in your own name and get your free credit reports. The divorce papers don't bind your lenders: until a shared debt is paid off, refinanced without your name, or the lender lets you off it, the lender can usually still make you pay.
props: If safety or financial control is a concern, first call the national domestic violence hotline (which connects callers with local help), then open an account in your own name and pull free credit reports
A decree does not bind lenders; a creditor can generally collect on a joint debt until it is paid off, refinanced without your name, or you are released
draft.counsel_body_if_taken: Divorce is the one transition in this list where professional counsel is close to mandatory: state property law decides what is marital, and agreements are hard to reopen. If a full-service lawyer is out of reach, look for legal aid or ask whether a lawyer will help with only part of the case. Build a complete list of accounts, debts and policies first; it is also the start of your own net-worth snapshot. Note the date the divorce becomes final: a former spouse married 10 years or more before that date may later draw Social Security on the other's record.

unverified.assertion: Mediation and the court's self-help center are affordable routes in divorce
unverified.why: Not read at a federal primary source; services vary by court and state. Left out of the text (only California's limited-scope page and the LSC statute were read).

unverified.assertion: Contact a domestic-violence advocate before starting
unverified.why: No federal agency page with this advice was read (CFPB pages found were a newsroom item and slides); replaced with the national hotline, which 42 U.S.C. 10413 establishes.

unverified.assertion: Changing a beneficiary form against a restraining order or decree can put you in contempt of court
unverified.why: Consequence not read at any primary source; not stated.

unverified.assertion: Support payments are often secured with life insurance named in the settlement
unverified.why: Frequency claim; only a court's power to order such insurance was read (California Fam. Code 4360). Text says 'may require ... for example'.

unverified.assertion: The spouse named as agent on a power of attorney or health care proxy can usually be replaced right away; ERISA spousal rights last until the divorce is final
unverified.why: POA revocation and termination rules are state law (the Uniform Power of Attorney Act is not law until a state enacts it) and were not read; ERISA spousal-consent timing not re-read today. Text uses an 'ask your lawyer' prompt instead.

unverified.assertion: State agencies enforce support orders generally (including spousal support)
unverified.why: Only child support enforcement was read at ACF; text narrowed to child support.

unverified.assertion: The hotline's phone number (and a text or chat option) belongs in the sentence
unverified.why: Not added: the federal page listing the number was not read today; adding it would also add a number to both variants. Owner may add it after reading the HHS/ACF page.

review.change: Limited-scope sentence reworded from 'look for ... a lawyer hired for only part of the case' to 'ask whether a lawyer will help with only part of the case'.
review.why: Only California's court page was read; limited-scope rules are set state by state, so the draft stated availability as universal. A prompt to ask makes no universal claim.

source.quote: A lawyer can handle some parts of your case while you handle others. This is called limited-scope representation.

review.change: Safety sentence reordered: call the national domestic violence hotline first (it connects callers with local help), then open an account and pull credit reports; 'start instead by' removed.
review.why: For a reader in an abusive or controlling marriage the safety contact should come before steps the other spouse might notice; the draft listed the hotline last and its 'start instead' clashed with 'first' in the inventory sentence. The added clause is supported by the statute's required activities.

source.quote: provide counseling and referral services for callers on a 24-hour-a-day basis, and directly connect callers to service providers

review.change: Joint-debt sentence: 'refinanced' became 'refinanced without your name', and 'generally' was added ('can generally still collect'; plain 'can usually still make you pay').
review.why: The CFPB conditions release on a refinance that removed your name and says 'generally' while noting state laws vary; a plain 'refinanced' could cover a refinance that kept both names, and the draft dropped the CFPB's hedge.

source.quote: While state laws vary, you are generally responsible for a debt unless you were contractually released by the creditor or your former spouse refinanced the loan and removed your name.

review.change: 'Some states bar beneficiary changes while the case is pending' became 'Your state may bar ...'; 'Check two limits first:' removed and 'as soon as you are allowed to' added to the file-new-forms sentence.
review.why: Only one state (California) was read, which supports 'may', not a count of states; and the draft told the reader to file new forms everywhere and only then to check limits first, an order a reader could act on before reading the caveat.
